plan.broker_email_subject: Please confirm IEEPA entry routes and next steps
plan.broker_email_body:
Hello,

Please confirm the routes and next steps for these entries. The entries appear eligible for the routes shown, but I understand that a refund is not guaranteed.

- KT4-2209566-1 — $4,260: withdraw the protest filed only for the IEEPA refund, then file in CAPE; deadline Nov 20, 2026.
- KT4-2209470-0 — $2,190: file in CAPE; deadline Dec 10, 2026.
- KT4-2210384-7 — $1,960: file in CAPE.
- KT4-2209003-5 — $8,820: file in CAPE Phase 2; it is flagged for reconciliation, with no type 09 reconciliation filing made.
- KT4-2207145-6 — $9,440; KT4-2207698-3 — $3,180; KT4-2208260-1 — $2,430; KT4-2208274-8 — $1,260: confirm the CAPE Phase 3 route with counsel.
- KT4-2210027-4 — $11,660: ask how CBP is treating this entry, which is not in CAPE today under the rules.
- KT4-2208011-9 — $8,070: it has an open protest and is past the 80-day period, so it stays on the protest route.
- KT4-2209318-2 — $3,500: it is linked to a drawback claim and is excluded from CAPE; please advise on handling.

Please confirm these routes and any needed next steps. Thank you,

[Your name]
North Trail Cycles Inc.
